title: Scheduling Board Layout Deck
request: Oct 19 2026: Max's review of the UpKeep Scheduling board, relayed by Swatch: two main sections (interactive Schedule with day/week/month, techs, visits and a TEST fill bar vs the 4-stop cap; Client Communications tracking cards per member, no contact buttons), To-Do in the header, Needs Attention, folded dropdowns, optional cards.
example_data: Drawn laptop SVG mockups with TEST data only: techs Tech Dash 1-3 and Van 1-3, members by first name or member ID, no contact or address data.
brands: Standard deck look (white, light beige accents, Khand/Hind)
Mockups: white/cream base, terracotta, lagoon and jungle accents, light only

pairs.ask: Scheduling Board: View switcher, should Day, Week and Month switch with a segmented button or underlined tabs?

optionA.label: Segmented Button
optionA.desc: Three joined buttons, the open view filled lagoon.
